name: Ductable AC units
tagline: Concealed cooling for whole floors and large halls
description: Hidden-in-ceiling systems that distribute conditioned air through ducts for tidy, centralised cooling.
long_description: A ductable unit sits above the ceiling or in a service area and sends cool air through insulated ducts to grilles or diffusers in each zone. One machine can serve several rooms or a large hall, and the interior shows only the grilles. Good duct design matters as much as the unit, so we plan airflow, static pressure and return paths together.
features: Fully concealed, with only grilles or diffusers on show
One unit can serve multiple rooms or a large open area
Supports fresh-air mixing and better filtration
Suitable for banquet halls, offices, villas and retail floors

specs.label: Static pressure
specs.value: Medium and high static options for longer duct runs

specs.label: Air distribution
specs.value: GI or pre-insulated ducting with grilles / diffusers

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: Wired wall controller; thermostat and BMS options

variants.suits: Villas, large halls and small offices

considerations: Duct design, insulation and return-air path decide real-world performance
Allow ceiling space for the unit, ducts and a service access panel
Zoning dampers can split one unit across rooms with different loads

faqs.question: Do you design the ducting too?
faqs.answer: Yes. We size the unit and ducts from the heat load, supply the ducting and grilles, and handle installation, insulation and balancing.

faqs.question: Ductable or VRF for an office?
faqs.answer: Ductable is lower cost for one large open zone. VRF suits many rooms that need separate temperature control.
